allow: PowerShell(npx eslint src/components/Header.jsx src/components/EnConstruccionPage.jsx src/App.jsx src/config/navigation.js)

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/Jefogarcia4/empanadasdlujo/actions/runs?per_page=6" -Headers @{ 'User-Agent' = 'claude-code' }; $r.workflow_runs | Select-Object -Property name, event, status, conclusion, head_branch, created_at, @{n='sha';e={$_.head_sha.Substring\(0,7\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200 } catch { "ERROR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($out = npx eslint src 2>&1 | Out-String; $errs = \([regex]::Matches\($out, "'motion' is defined but never used"\)\).Count; "Archivos con el mismo falso positivo de 'motion' en todo src/: $errs"; \($out -split "`n" | Select-String "problem"\))

PowerShell(npm run build 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "error|Error|built in|dist/assets" | Select-Object -First 8; "--- lint \(solo errores nuevos, ignorando el falso positivo de motion\) ---"; $out = npx eslint src/components/nosotros 2>&1 | Out-String; \($out -split "`n" | Select-String -NotMatch "'motion' is defined" | Select-String "error|problem"\))
